sourceSentences: [0] Karma's very good into Renata because she can't really do anything to trade with your Mantra Q. She could only shield the damage.
[0] Karma is very good into most enchanters for that same reason. She can pretty much outrange most of them because RQ range is insane.
[0] Because Renata is a terrible blind. If you play a poke champ like Karma into her, she's just so useless. Renata is really good into dive comps.
[0] It's just this lane is going to be really hard for her. I'm just walking up and poking.
[1] high poke and shield, dont expect to win extended poke fights. Her shield gives MS, making it easier for opponents do dodge glasc q and r. Same as other poke champs, play with the jungler/mid.
[2] She doesn't really do much. Poke her out and be aware of her W as it can turn around fights and make you lose the lane. Q is super easy to dodge with your E. Shield her poke.
[2] Bait her E out, else u don't want to trade against her aa E aa since she blocks your Q with it. Go for Poke or Slower fights. If she used her W and its on CD, you can try to get a Kill.

[2] Karma hard wins Renata Glasc Has very long cooldowns. Punish when she uses any ability. It is also super easy to outrun Hostile Takeover. Even if you are hooked, you can look to turn it with Renewal.
[2] Laning phase should be pretty easy. If her Q is on cooldown, you can just run at her.
[2] Renata is actually not that hard given that you can give your team space to disengage from her ulti.
